name: ParametricNoise orthogonalize and hypersphere rotate
plain: Orthogonalize removes noise A's component from noise B (Gram-Schmidt per batch item over the flattened tensor) and, by default, rescales the result back to B's original norm with one scalar, so A and the result are decorrelated. HypersphereRotate turns A by an angle inside the plane spanned by A and B, at A's magnitude: 0° gives A, 90° gives the part of B orthogonal to A, 180° gives −A. If B is nearly parallel to A it uses a rolled copy of A as the second axis.
math:
Symbols: a, b flattened per batch item; û=a/|a|.
Orthogonalize: b⊥ = b − s·(b·a)/(a·a)·a; optional b⊥ ← b⊥·|b|/|b⊥|.
Rotate: v = normalize(b − (b·û)û); out = (cosθ·û + sinθ·v)·|a|.

props.params: Orthogonalize strength 1, normalize on; Rotate angle 90°, normalize off
